name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: USB hubs with source recovery without Ethernet and clear eject progress.
description: Connect up to eight USB sticks through a hub, including HFS+. Hub sources work without Ethernet and recover at power-on. Native sources appear first, then numbered hub ports. Shows rekordbox names/colors and waveforms. Press USB STOP to select a stick or hold to eject the hub. The eject panel stays visible until safe removal or failure. Use touch if knob input stops. Experimental Ethernet sharing; actual CDJs and Wi-Fi sharing remain unvalidated. Large libraries may exceed sharing limits. Requires firmware ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel4.4.194 and core>=1.2.3.
